top.title: Tata Motors PV slides as JLR cuts outlook
top.line: JLR now sees FY27 EBIT margin of 2–3% versus 4%, and a £1.25 billion cash outflow
more: The stock fell 7.5% to ₹265.90 in one report, nearly 9% in another
Analysts cite weak China demand, MENA disruption and an unfavourable mix
Q2 net loss is reported as ₹5,451 crore in one source, ₹5,531 crore in another

top.title: Pricol plunges 20% on Warburg stake deal
top.line: Warburg will buy promoters' 38.51% of demerged Pricol Autotech for up to ₹1,663 crore
more: The stake is in the demerged unit, not in Pricol Ltd itself
Warburg will also make an open offer for up to 26% more of Pricol Autotech
The deal depends on the demerger, listing and regulatory approvals
